title: An Explainable Equity-Aware P2P Energy Trading Framework for Socio-Economically Diverse Microgrid
reasoning: The paper focuses on optimization of a microgrid energy trading system using Mixed-Integer Linear Programming and Reinforcement Learning. While it incorporates 'Rawlsian fairness' and 'equity' as design principles and optimization constraints, it is an engineering paper evaluating technical system performance and socio-economic outcomes rather than a study or benchmark of religious beliefs, morals, or ethical reasoning in AI agents or language models.
